en: ...Hey, Stayen. Can I ask you something?

jp: 本を読むことが好きで
ちょっと生意気な男の子よ
en: ...Let's see. He loves reading books, and he's a bit of a cheeky boy.

jp: ボクはちょっと苦手だな
en: Books, huh... I'm not very good with them.

jp: カインは部屋で本を読むより
外で遊んでる方が似合うわ
en: Hee hee. Playing outside suits you better than reading in a room, Cain.

jp: キロタも子供なんだから
en: Kilota's a child too. He should have played outside more...

jp: キロタ、今頃どうしているのかな
en: I wonder how Kilota is doing right now.

jp: くよくよしてても仕方ないわ
こうなったら、何が何でも
キロタを助けなきゃね
en: No use moping. Now it's come to this, I have to save Kilota, whatever it takes.

jp: それに、マティアも助ける
en: I'll help too. And we'll save Matia as well.

jp: 二人とも必ず助けに行くわ
en: Yes, that's right. We'll go save them both, no matter what.
